title: Red Dead Redemption 2
description:
America, 1899. Arthur Morgan rides with the Van der Linde gang as the law closes in and the age of outlaws comes to an end. Hunt, fish, rob trains and get to know the gang across a huge open world of mountains, swamps and frontier towns.

The PC version includes Red Dead Online, where you build your own life on the frontier with friends.
requirements: Nvidia GeForce GTX 770 2GB / AMD Radeon R9 280 3GB

title: Split Fiction
description:
Two writers, Mio and Zoe, get trapped inside their own stories by a machine built to steal ideas. To escape, they jump between a neon sci-fi city and a world of dragons and magic, with new mechanics in almost every level.

Split Fiction is co-op only: play with a friend online or on the same screen. Thanks to the Friend's Pass, your partner can join for free.
requirements: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 - 4GB or Radeon RX 470 - 4GB
Resolution: 1920x1080 Native FPS: 30 Graphics Settings Preset: Low

title: EA SPORTS FIFA 23
description:
The last FIFA under the old name brings HyperMotion2 animation, the men's and women's World Cups, and women's club football for the first time.

Build a squad in Ultimate Team, play a full Career Mode season, or take your matches online with cross-play.
requirements: Intel Core i5 6600k or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570

trailer.title: FIFA 23 | Official Launch Trailer | The World’s Game

title: Cyberpunk 2077
description:
You are V, a mercenary in Night City, a megacity obsessed with power, glamour and cybernetic upgrades. A heist goes wrong and leaves a digital ghost in your head, and you have limited time to get rid of it.

Customise your cyberware and playstyle, then shoot, hack or talk your way through a story that changes with your choices.
requirements: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB or Arc A380

SSD required. Attention: In this game you will encounter a variety of visual effects that may provide seizures or loss of consciousness in a minority of people. If you or someone you know experiences any of the above symptoms while playing, stop and seek medical attention immediately.

trailer.title: Cyberpunk 2077 | Broken Dreams | Edgerunners 2 Update Launch Trailer

title: Elden Ring
description:
Rise, Tarnished, and explore the Lands Between, a vast open world created by FromSoftware with worldbuilding by George R. R. Martin. Ride across open fields, dive into hidden dungeons and face enormous bosses at your own pace.

Build your character however you like with weapons, armour and sorceries, and call on other players for help or invade their worlds.
requirements: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD RADEON RX 580 4 GB

trailer.title: ELDEN RING Launch Trailer - EN PEGI

title: Baldur's Gate 3
description:
Gather a party and return to the Forgotten Realms in a story-rich RPG built on Dungeons & Dragons 5th edition rules. A mind flayer parasite gives you strange powers, and how you use them is up to you.

Turn-based combat, hundreds of choices with real consequences, and up to four-player co-op make every playthrough different.
requirements: Intel I5 4690 / AMD FX 8350 / Snapdragon X Elite
Nvidia GTX 970 / RX 480 / Intel Arc A380 / Qualcomm Adreno X1 (4GB+ of VRAM)

title: Hogwarts Legacy
description:
Attend Hogwarts in the 1800s as a student who holds the key to an ancient secret. Learn spells, brew potions, tame magical beasts and explore the castle, Hogsmeade and the Highlands beyond.

Choose your house, shape your wizard and decide what kind of witch or wizard you become.
requirements: Intel Core i5-6600 (3.3Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (3.2Ghz)
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 470 4GB
SSD (Preferred), HDD (Supported), 720p/30 fps, Low Quality Settings

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description:
As Geralt of Rivia, a monster hunter for hire, search a war-torn open world for Ciri, the child of prophecy, before the Wild Hunt finds her first.

This edition includes the next-gen update with improved visuals, plus both expansions: Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine.
requirements: GeForce GTX 1660 / Radeon RX 5500 XT 8GB / Arc A580

trailer.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered | Official Launch Trailer

title: Grand Theft Auto V
description:
Three very different criminals, Michael, Franklin and Trevor, take on Los Santos in a series of daring heists. Switch between them at any time across a sprawling city and countryside.

Includes GTA Online, an ever-growing world of races, missions and businesses to run with friends.
requirements: Intel Core 2 Quad CPU Q6600 @ 2.40GHz (4 CPUs) / AMD Phenom 9850 Quad-Core Processor (4 CPUs) @ 2.5GHz

title: Stardew Valley
description:
You inherit your grandfather's old farm in Pelican Town. Clear the land, grow crops, raise animals, go fishing and mining, and become part of a small community.

Play solo or with up to seven friends in online co-op.

title: Hades
description:
As Zagreus, the immortal son of Hades, fight your way out of the Underworld. Every escape attempt is different, with boons from the gods of Olympus changing how you fight.

Die, return home, grow stronger and get to know a cast of fully voiced characters as the story unfolds run after run.

title: Hollow Knight
description:
Descend into Hallownest, a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, fight tough bosses and uncover the secrets of the kingdom's fall.

A hand-drawn action adventure with classic exploration: new abilities open up new paths across the map.

title: It Takes Two
description:
Cody and May are getting divorced, until their daughter's wish turns them into dolls. To get back to normal they have to work together through a wildly creative adventure.

Co-op only, online or on the same screen. A Friend's Pass lets your partner play for free.
requirements: Intel Core i3-2100T or AMD FX 6100
Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 or AMD R7 260x

title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
description:
In late-1500s Japan, a shinobi known as the One-Armed Wolf sets out to rescue his young lord and take revenge. Use your prosthetic arm's tools and a grappling hook to fight and move through the world.

Combat is built around deflecting attacks and breaking your opponent's posture. This Game of the Year edition adds extra content.
publisher: Activision (Excluding Japan and Asia), FromSoftware, Inc. (Japan), 方块游戏 (Asia)
requirements: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 | AMD Radeon HD 7950

trailer.title: Sekiro™: Shadows Die Twice - Game of the Year Edition

title: Forza Horizon 5
description:
Drive hundreds of the world's greatest cars across a huge open-world Mexico, from jungles and beaches to volcanoes and deserts.

Race, explore and create events solo or with friends online.
requirements: NVidia GTX 970, AMD RX 470, OR Intel Arc A380

title: Black Myth: Wukong
description:
An action RPG rooted in the Chinese classic Journey to the West. As the Destined One, travel through striking landscapes and face powerful enemies drawn from mythology.

Combine staff stances, spells and transformations to find your own way to fight.
requirements: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
HDD Supported, SSD Recommended. The above specifications were tested with DLSS/FSR/XeSS enabled.

title: Helldivers 2
description:
Join the Helldivers and spread managed democracy across the galaxy in a co-op third-person shooter for up to four players.

Call in airstrikes and supply drops, complete missions on hostile planets, and watch out for friendly fire.
requirements: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470

title: Terraria
description:
Dig, fight, explore and build in a 2D sandbox world that is different every time you start. Craft gear from what you find and take on dozens of bosses.

Play alone or with friends online.
requirements: 128mb Video Memory, capable of Shader Model 2.0+

title: Portal 2
description:
Solve physics puzzles with the portal gun in the Aperture Science labs, with the AI GLaDOS watching your every move.

Includes a single-player story and a separate two-player co-op campaign.
requirements: 3.0 GHz P4, Dual Core 2.0 (or higher) or AMD64X2 (or higher)
Video card must be 128 MB or more and with support for Pixel Shader 2.0b (ATI Radeon X800 or higher / NVIDIA GeForce 7600 or higher / Intel HD Graphics 2000 or higher).

title: Celeste
description:
Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain. A tight, challenging platformer with hundreds of hand-crafted screens.

An Assist Mode lets you adjust the difficulty to your liking.
developer: Maddy Makes Games Inc., Extremely OK Games, Ltd.

title: Monster Hunter: World
description:
Hunt huge monsters across a living ecosystem, then craft better weapons and armour from what you collect.

Hunt alone or team up with up to three other hunters online.
requirements: Intel Core i5-4460 / Intel Core i3-9100F / AMD FX-6300 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon R7 260x / AMD Radeon RX 560
- These specs allow for the game to be played in 1080p/30fps with graphics settings at "Low". - 64-bit processor and operating system are required.

title: Resident Evil 4
description:
Agent Leon S. Kennedy is sent to a remote European village to rescue the President's kidnapped daughter. This remake of the 2005 survival-horror classic is rebuilt from the ground up.

Modernised controls and visuals keep the original's tension and action.
requirements: AMD Radeon RX 560 with 4GB VRAM / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti with 4GB VRAM

Estimated performance (when set to Prioritize Performance): 1080p/45fps. ・Framerate might drop in graphics-intensive scenes. ・AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 required to support ray tracing.

title: Dark Souls III
description:
As the fires fade and the world falls into ruin, journey through a dark fantasy world full of dangerous enemies and huge bosses.

Fast, tough combat rewards patience. Other players can help you or invade your world.
requirements: NVIDIA® GeForce GTX 750 Ti / ATI Radeon HD 7950
Internet connection required for online play and product activation

title: DOOM Eternal
description:
Hell's armies have invaded Earth. As the DOOM Slayer, rip and tear through demon hordes across dimensions with a powerful arsenal.

Fast, aggressive combat rewards staying on the move.
requirements: Intel Core i5 @ 3.3 GHz or better, or AMD Ryzen 3 @ 3.1 GHz or better
NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050Ti (4GB), GTX 1060 (3GB), GTX 1650 (4GB) or AMD Radeon R9 280(3GB), AMD Radeon R9 290 (4GB), RX 470 (4GB)

title: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree
description:
The expansion to Elden Ring. Follow Miquella into the Realm of Shadow, a new land as large as many full games, with new weapons, spells, armour and some of FromSoftware's toughest bosses.

Requires the base game Elden Ring.
requirements: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD RADEON RX 580 4 GB

trailer.title: ELDEN RING Shadow of the Erdtree - Accolades Trailer

title: Cyberpunk 2077 Phantom Liberty
description:
A spy-thriller expansion for Cyberpunk 2077. As V, take on a mission to save the President of the New United States in Dogtown, a new district of Night City.

Requires the base game Cyberpunk 2077.
requirements: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB or Arc A380

Attention: see upcoming change to the requirements. Storage: 35 GB SSD. In this game you will encounter a variety of visual effects that may provide seizures or loss of consciousness in a minority of people. If you or someone you know experiences any of the above symptoms while playing, stop and seek medical attention immediately.

title: Wallpaper Engine
description:
Use animated and interactive wallpapers on your Windows desktop. Pick from a huge community workshop or make your own with the built-in editor.

Wallpapers pause automatically while you play a game, so they don't cost performance.
requirements: Windows N versions require the 'Media Feature Pack' from Microsoft.

title: Aseprite
description: A pixel-art and animation editor used by many indie game developers. Draw sprites, animate them frame by frame with onion skinning, and export sprite sheets.
